Sub: Audio Recording of Earnings Call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

an Earnings Call on August 05, 2026, and an investor presentation arising thereto were provided,

Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the said Earnings Call is available on

URL https://ccreservations.com/recordings/select_recordings.php
